```python
# Tries every width w, cuts S into rows of w characters and checks whether any column reads T
import math

s, t = input().split()
s, t = s.strip(), t.strip()

    x = [*zip(*ss)]
    for n in x:
        if t == "".join(n).strip():

            exit(0)
